name: Gencor Industries, Inc.
summary: Gencor Industries, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of heavy machinery used in the production of highway construction materials and environmental control equipment. The company offers hot-mix asphalt plants, hot-mix storage silos, fabric filtration systems, cold feed bins, and other plant components, as well as counter flow drum mix technology and batch plants. It also provides combustion systems for rotary dryers, kilns, fume and liquid incinerators, and fuel heaters; Hy-Way Heat and beverley lines of thermal fluid heat transfer systems, and specialty storage tanks; and asphalt pavers under the Blaw-Knox brand.
